## NYSEDataSource

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Infrastructure.Adapters.NYSE.NYSEDataSource</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Infrastructure/Adapters/NYSE/NYSEDataSource.cs:52](../../../../src/Meridian.Infrastructure/Adapters/NYSE/NYSEDataSource.cs#L52).

NYSE Direct Connection data source providing real-time and historical market data directly from the New York Stock Exchange. Features: - Real-time trades and quotes via NYSE Integrated Feed - Historical daily OHLCV bars via NYSE Historical Data API - Level 2 market depth (Premium/Professional tiers) - Trade conditions and participant IDs - Pre-market and after-hours data - Corporate actions (dividends, splits) Requires NYSE Connect API credentials and appropriate data subscriptions.

## NyseNationalTradesCsvParser

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Infrastructure.Adapters.NYSE.NyseNationalTradesCsvParser</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Infrastructure/Adapters/NYSE/NyseNationalTradesCsvParser.cs:39](../../../../src/Meridian.Infrastructure/Adapters/NYSE/NyseNationalTradesCsvParser.cs#L39).

Parser for NYSE TAQ (Trade and Quote) National Trades CSV files. File format: EQY_US_TAQ_NATIONAL_TRADES_YYYYMMDD.gz Distributed via NYSE FTP: ftp.nyse.com/Historical Data Samples/TAQ NYSE NATIONAL TRADES/ Message types in the CSV: 3 - Symbol summary record (open price, daily statistics) 34 - Trading status record (halt, resume, etc.) 220 - Trade print record (actual executed trades) Type-220 column layout (1-indexed): 1 msg_type : Always 220 2 global_seq_num : SIP-assigned sequence number (unique within day) 3 time : HH:MM:SS.nnnnnnnnn (nanosecond precision, Eastern Time) 4 symbol : Ticker symbol (may contain spaces for test symbols) 5 exchange_code : Numeric SIP participant code for reporting exchange 6 exch_seq_num : Exchange-provided trade sequence number 7 price : Trade price (decimal; may omit leading zero, e.g., &quot;.1185&quot;) 8 volume : Trade volume (shares) 9 sale_condition : Sale condition character(s) (e.g., &quot;@&quot; = regular round-lot) 10 correction : Correction indicator (&quot;F&quot; = final correction, &quot; &quot; = normal) 11 tape : Consolidated tape (&quot;T&quot; = Tape A/NYSE-listed, &quot; &quot; = other) 12 stopped_stock : Stopped stock indicator (&quot;I&quot; = stopped/indicated, &quot; &quot; = normal) Exchange codes (field 5) — SIP participant numbering: 4 = NYSE Arca (P) 5 = NYSE (N) 6 = CBOE EDGX (K) 7 = CBOE EDGA (J) 8 = CBOE BZX (Z) 9 = CBOE BYX (Y) 10 = NYSE American (A) 11 = NASDAQ (Q) 12 = NASDAQ BX (B) 13 = IEX (V) 14 = MEMX (U) 15 = LTSE (L)


## PolygonMarketDataClient

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Infrastructure.Adapters.Polygon.PolygonMarketDataClient</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Infrastructure/Adapters/Polygon/PolygonMarketDataClient.cs:49](../../../../src/Meridian.Infrastructure/Adapters/Polygon/PolygonMarketDataClient.cs#L49).

Polygon.io market data adapter implementing the IMarketDataClient abstraction. Supports full WebSocket streaming for trades, quotes, and aggregates. Extends WebSocketProviderBase, which centralises connection lifecycle, resilience (retry + circuit breaker), heartbeat monitoring, and automatic reconnection. ~280 LOC of WebSocket boilerplate removed compared to the previous direct implementation. Current support: - Trades: YES (streams &quot;T&quot; messages and forwards to TradeDataCollector) - Quotes: YES (streams &quot;Q&quot; messages and forwards to QuoteCollector) - Aggregates: YES (streams &quot;A&quot; and &quot;AM&quot; messages for second/minute bars) Polygon WebSocket Protocol: - Endpoint: wss://socket.polygon.io/{feed} (stocks, options, forex, crypto) - Auth: Send {&quot;action&quot;:&quot;auth&quot;,&quot;params&quot;:&quot;{apiKey}&quot;} after connect - Subscribe: {&quot;action&quot;:&quot;subscribe&quot;,&quot;params&quot;:&quot;T.AAPL,Q.AAPL&quot;} - Message types: T=trade, Q=quote, A=aggregate, AM=minute aggregate

## RobinhoodBrokerageGateway

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Infrastructure.Adapters.Robinhood.RobinhoodBrokerageGateway</code>. Kind: `class`.

Robinhood brokerage gateway for live order execution via the unofficial Robinhood API. Uses REST for order management and a bounded channel for execution report streaming. Important: Robinhood does not publish an official public API. This gateway targets the same endpoints used by the Robinhood mobile application. Set ROBINHOOD_ACCESS_TOKEN to your personal access token. Order types supported: market, limit, stop, stop-limit. Order modification is implemented as cancel + resubmit (Robinhood does not support in-place order modification via the unofficial API).

## RobinhoodHistoricalDataProvider

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Infrastructure.Adapters.Robinhood.RobinhoodHistoricalDataProvider</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Infrastructure/Adapters/Robinhood/RobinhoodHistoricalDataProvider.cs:50](../../../../src/Meridian.Infrastructure/Adapters/Robinhood/RobinhoodHistoricalDataProvider.cs#L50).

Historical data provider using the Robinhood unofficial API. Provides daily OHLCV bars for US equities via Bearer-token authentication. Important: Robinhood does not publish an official public API. This provider targets the same endpoints used by the Robinhood mobile application. Users must supply a personal access token via the ROBINHOOD_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable. Tokens can be obtained through the Robinhood OAuth2 login flow or from a valid browser/app session. Rate limit: the endpoint is undocumented; the provider defaults to 100 req/hour to avoid triggering abuse-detection heuristics. Adjust RateLimitPerHour in config if needed. Coverage: US equities and ETFs traded on Robinhood&#x27;s platform.

Polling-based market data client using the Robinhood unofficial API. Provides real-time BBO quotes for US equities via polling the quotes endpoint. Important: Robinhood does not provide a public WebSocket API. This client uses REST polling (default interval: 2 seconds) as the closest available substitute for streaming quotes. Authentication: set ROBINHOOD_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable. Trade data and market depth are not available via the Robinhood unofficial API.

Template brokerage gateway scaffold. Copy this file and fill in the TODOs to implement a new brokerage provider. Steps to implement a new brokerage: 1. Copy this file to a new folder under Adapters/{BrokerName}/ 2. Rename the class to {BrokerName}BrokerageGateway 3. Replace the template &#91;DataSource&#93; and &#91;ImplementsAdr&#93; metadata with broker-specific values 4. Replace scaffold methods with broker-specific API calls 5. Add JSON DTOs and a JsonSerializerContext for ADR-014 compliance 6. Register in DI: services.AddBrokerageGateway&lt;{BrokerName}BrokerageGateway&gt;() 7. Add configuration options record if needed 8. Add tests under tests/Meridian.Tests/Brokerage/
